issue_context.title: Customizable asset root directory
issue_context.body:
## What problem does this solve or what need does it fill?

My use case: I want to make a launcher (think Steam / Origin) where the basic interaction is:
- Step 1: Choose a game and launch it
- Step 2: Play then exit the game (go to Step 1)
- Be resistant to crashes, worst case should be to go back to the launcher (step 1).

[My implementation](https://github.com/Vrixyz/Launcher/blob/1069e7261fb0a48064427942ca54d3ee9b0d6486/src/main.rs#L33) uses a new process to launch the game, where each game is "isolated" in its own folder, but `std::env::current_exe()` returns the parent executable rather than the child's, **resulting in incorrect assets root directory**. 

Bevy use of `std::env::current_exe()`:
https://github.com/bevyengine/bevy/blob/dc3b4b6c850898c922dff9fd6d312823e07096f1/crates/bevy_asset/src/io/file_asset_io.rs#L69

## What solution would you like?

Follow [this PR discussion](https://github.com/bevyengine/bevy/pull/1801) to support a `BEVY_ASSET_ROOT` env variable having priority over `std::env::current_exe()`

## Alternatives

For my use case, overriding `CARGO_MANIFEST_DIR` happens to work, but as stated [in discussion](https://github.com/bevyengine/bevy/pull/1801#issuecomment-822817262), it "feels wrong".

review_comments: Would be good to add/update this in the docs for [AssetServer.load](https://docs.rs/bevy/latest/bevy/asset/struct.AssetServer.html#method.load) too (3rd paragraph). I think it would be more discoverable as it's used by the end user more than get_base_path.
